harper: FYI packaging wants to switch RC-10 for Private/VPC customers to a sealed shrinkwrap bundle tonight. Staging start 04:00 UTC. Primary reasons: deterministic install and easier mirror rollbacks.
jules: any KMS/cosign plan? We had key rotation scheduled but can shift.
mike: HSM window conflicts at 04:30. Proposal: use current HSM key if available; otherwise fallback to software key in vault. No rotation tonight. Will annotate release notes.
harper: agreed. Packaging: provide cosign id + sha256 when ready.
packaging: cosign id=shrinkwrap-rc10-v1 (HSM primary), sha256=9f8b2a...c3 stored in signing-table. TTL check shows 9d remaining.
harper: rollback decision summary: 1) cosign/sha mismatch -> abort publish, no swap. 2) canary health failures within 12m (>=2 pod restarts OR readiness <50%) -> automatic mirror-swap to previous sealed manifest. 3) perf regressions -> manual rollback after 20m investigation.
jules: deploybot, run dry-run and check mirror D disk and bandwidth. @deploybot
deploybot: dry-run scheduled for manifest=sealed-rc-10-20260323. Results: mirrorD disk=18% (warning), mirror-edge OK. Warning log: /var/log/deploybot/dryrun-3301004321.log
ops-bot: excluding mirrorD from canary due to disk pressure. mirrors=[mirror-edge, mirror-A]. :white_check_mark:
mike: preflight snippet for oncall:
```
sha256sum sealed-rc10.tar.gz -> 9f8b2a...c3
cosign verify --key k8s://projects/redwood/cosign/shrinkwrap-rc10 sealed-rc10.tar.gz
kubectl -n redwood get deploy redwood-runtime -o jsonpath='{.status.conditions}'
```
jules: rollback command for quick revert:
```
/deploybot mirror-swap --to-manifest=sealed-rc-9-20260228 --force --reason="canary_fail"
```
harper: canary plan: targets=[mirror-edge, mirror-A], traffic cap 12% first 30m, ramp to 100% over 60m if green. If canary fails, immediate swap.
deplybot: promote-dryrun status=success manifest=sealed-rc-10-20260323 warnings=["mirrorD_disk<20%"]
ops-bot: traffic policy applied to canary targets.
packaging: cosign completed 04:06 UTC, sha256 recorded. Starting push to mirrors.
deploybot: mirror-push status=partial succeeded=2 failed=0 pending=0
harper: canary 10m check: no restarts, readiness 98%. Proceeding with ramp per policy.
release-coordinator: publishing notes and pinging customers at 04:45 UTC. Filing PACK-4955 for post-release verification.
jules: thanks all. Closing unless someone reopens.
